items.title: Snowboard Racing
items.creator: UUUM
items.description:
Enjoy a high quality snowboard race!
Take the item boxes in the race course and beat your rivals!

- Multiplayer and Singleplayer available
- Various courses available
- Lots of special power-up items for the race 
- A number of new BGMs

items.title: Archer's Strike
items.creator: UUUM
items.description:
Hit the targets in the course and earn many points on an automated vehicle in this fantasy world!
Aim for the high-score-targets scattered around the world and become No. 1!
Coop or fight with your friends in multiplay!

- Various courses available 
- Multiplayer and Singleplayer available

items.title: Anime Squad
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
Meet up with your squad, and put on some stylish outfits! With a variety of simplistic designs, there's something here for everyone!

+ 10 teenage skins
+ Cool grey outfits

items.title: Cat Pajamas
items.creator: UnderBlocks Studios
items.description: These Cat Pajamas are pretty soft!

items.title: Modern Planes
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Flight 12 is now departing! Welcome to Modern Planes! Boasting over 5 custom aircraft, a full airport lounge, a hangar, an ATC tower, and more! You're bound to have tons of fun! 

- Includes 2 helicopters
- Great for roleplay
- Private jets
- Licensed by 5 Frame Studios and published by BLOCKLAB Studios

items.title: Pig Mansion
items.creator: Vertexcubed
items.description:
Oink oink, welcome to Pig Mansion, a funny re-visit to the now classic Minecraft mob. Relax yourself in the luxurious olympic pool, or go plant crops and take care of the pig’s. See how much you can expand your farm. 

+ Mob inspired Pig Mansion
+ Animal farms for survival 
+ A modern mansion on an island
+ Guide book to the farm life

items.title: Private Millionaire Island
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
Ever wonder what it feels like to have your very own private island? Travel into the world and live like a millionaire!

- 4 millionaire's supercars!
- Luxurious millionaire's mansion!
- private outdoor activities!
- Live alone or with your friends!

And much more!

items.title: One Block Realms
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
One block like never before! Explore the map and conquer the challenges to unlock the desert, snow, mesa, nether, and the colorful realm! Can you survive?

- 6 unique realms to obtain various resources!
- 4 unique challenges!
- Classic area to explore all sorts of biomes!
- And much more!

items.title: Alien Worlds - Texture Pack
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
How would alien life evolve in the world of Minecraft? How would it feel to explore the overworld of an alien planet?
Transform any world into an organic, vivid extraterrestrial planet with this super sharp, photorealistic resource pack.

-64x hyperrealistic resource pack
-Advanced geometry mob designs
-Perfect for roleplay, building and exploring
-SCP ready
-12 HD skins

items.title: Block Gamers
items.creator: Pixelationz Studios
items.description: Love blocks? Love gaming? Then you'll love Block Gamers! Choose from a selection of 15 trendy skins and choose the one that is right for you. Happy gaming!

items.title: PvP Anime
items.creator: Glorious Studios
items.description:
Do you like PvP and Anime? Then this pack is for you! Put on these outfits, join the battle and win your fights with these skins made for Anime and PvP/PvE fans!

+ 1 free skin
+ 12 PvP Anime skins

items.title: Modern Sky Survival
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Pixel Creations presents: Modern Sky Survival! Are you ready for some amazing sky survival exploration? Explore islands and buildings on them, find hidden epic tools with custom enchantments, and make your city.

+ Custom enchantments
+ Bunkers
+ Mine
+ Police station
+ Fire station
+ Hospital
+ Licensed by Pixel Creations and published by BLOCKLAB Studios

items.title: Skyblock Time Challenge
items.creator: Cubed Creations
items.description:
Are you ready for this ultimate skyblock challenge? A fast paced hardcore game where you have limited time to complete a challenge. For every task completed, you get a new challenge with a new sky block island. Be quick, because if you're too late... ehh nevermind... just be quick!

+3 gamemodes!
+20+ Different islands!
+300+ Unique challenges!
+Unique skyblock experience!

items.title: Animal Tower Defense
items.creator: Sandbox Network
items.description:
A huge gate of nether opens in the peaceful bear forest, and nether monsters invade! Use 8 different animal towers to stop the nether monsters!

- Only singleplayer
- 8 animal towers
- 21 stages
- 3 difficulty levels
- 4 skins

items.title: Speedrunners
items.creator: Cypress Games
items.description:
Who is the fastest player in the game? Come on, show them the answer to this question! Choose your favorite skin and prove who is the fastest player in the game!

+ 16 skins including 2 that are FREE!
+ Speedrun themed
+ Perfect for roleplay

items.title: K-POP ARMY
items.creator: Cypress Games
items.description:
Are you ready to show off to other players with these awesome KPOP themed skins? You will definitely be one of the coolest player in the game! 

+ 12 skins (2 free)
+ KPOP themed
+ Perfect for roleplay

items.title: Block Armors
items.creator: Cypress Games
items.description:
Are you ready to have the strongest looking skins? All of the skins in this pack look extremely strong and cool! Come on, show other players who's stronger!

+ 15 skins (2 free)
+ Perfect for roleplay

items.title: UwU Teens
items.creator: Cypress Games
items.description:
Are you ready to impress your friends with your sweetness! If you're ready, you can show everyone who the sweetest player is with this skin pack. They will surely admire your sweetness!

+ 12 skins including 2 that are FREE!
+ Perfect for roleplay

items.title: Skyblock Masters
items.creator: Cypress Games
items.description:
Are you a skyblock master? Then these skins are perfect for you! Choose your favorite skin and start a unique adventure now! Come on, it's time to build a kingdom in the sky!

+ 12 skins including 2 that are FREE!
+ Perfect for skyblock
+ Perfect for roleplay

items.title: Warden Jobs
items.creator: Cypress Games
items.description:
Have you ever seen a worker Warden? If you haven't seen it before, you will see it in this pack! Choose your favorite job now and get to work!

+ 12 skins including 2 that are free!
+ Warden themed
+ Perfect for roleplay

items.title: Animal Onesies
items.creator: Cypress Games
items.description:
With these Onesies skins, you will be the cutest player in the game! Get ready for a slumber party and show off your coolest and lovable skin to everyone!

+ 12 skins (2 free)
+ Onesies themed
+ Perfect for roleplay

items.title: Streetwear Teens
items.creator: Mine-North
items.description:
Chill with your friends and be the coolest with your new streetwear style. Be the fashion boss on the streets.

+ Teens
+ Roleplay
+ Parkour

Created by Mine-North

items.title: Party Mansion
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description:
Get ready to party! Live your life in a party mansion!

+ Rich party mansion!
+ By Nitric Concepts

items.title: Blingy Outfits
items.creator: Team Visionary
items.description:
Be the king of this land and reign over each squad! Become the bling master in this town and set new benchmarks in the fashion world. Enjoy all the different styles, from wearing a suit to becoming the shining star of the party! You are a true champion!

+ 1 free skin
+ 12 skins
+ By Team Visionary
